research_question: What subluminal mission velocity is credible for a stated payload when relativistic energy, propulsion, braking, ISM damage, radiation, and human constraints are jointly modeled?
hard_invariants: A massive craft is not claimed to reach or exceed c.
All proposed outcomes must distinguish flyby from rendezvous.
A molecular or material concept is not treated as a verified propulsion breakthrough.
No observed experiment or mission result may be invented.
recommended_direction_space: Relativistic ISM damage and shield-mass model
